name: Anarch Thaumaturgical Rituals — 2 Intermediate — Ward Versus Vitae

system.description: After anointing an object with a sigil drawn in her own blood while chanting, the caster creates a ward keyed specifically against Kindred of lower generation than herself (not a general "ward versus Kindred"). It can be inscribed on any object from dagger- to door-sized, and inflicts one Trait of lethal damage — bypassing armor and other mystical protections — on any lower-generation Kindred who crosses the warded threshold or touches the object. It functions as a normal ward otherwise and lasts until the following night; it may be applied to multiple exits/entrances in a room if repeated for each, but cannot be stacked multiple times on a single item or entrance.
